system.description:
Only affects a specific body part or section. Source: BESM4e.

  • Level 1: Affects a large part of the body (torso, both legs or arms, etc.)
  • Level 2: Affects a small part of the body (one leg or arm, abdomen, chest, head, etc.)
  • Level 3: Affects a tiny part of the body (one hand or foot, face, groin, knee, etc.)
